messages:
maya: Quick check — SOC2 rotation milestone: who'll own the key provenance evidence for the March rotation? We need export, annotated timeline, and signed attestation. cc @samir @liz @infra-sre

samir: I can pick up the evidence pack. Need auditlog exports with KMS events and the HSM attestation bundle. @infra-sre any blockers on export or retention?

infra-sre: Logs are in longterm bucket but retention currently 90d. We can backfill to 13mo but it will take a few hours. Give me exact time range and destination.

samir: Range = 2024-03-01..2024-03-05 (rotation window). Put to s3://redwood-compliance/kms-rotation-2024-03/. Use `auditlog-export --service=kms --from=2024-03-01 --to=2024-03-05 --out=s3://redwood-compliance/kms-rotation-2024-03/`

liz: I have the HSM attestation signed PDF and the key ceremony notes. I'll upload to the same bucket under attestation/ and add a README with owners. Will also link PR for evidence checklist.

security-bot: Reminder: Control CC-1 requires evidence retention >= 12 months. Flagging for reviewers. :bell:

maya: Great — can someone add the evidence owner field in the control tracker (docs/controls/soc2/table)? I can run the final QA after upload. Deadline EOD Friday. :calendar:

infra-sre: Started export job, ETA ~2h. Job id `export-20240305-7f9a`. I'll post checksum when done.

samir: Awesome. I'll draft the evidence manifest and the attestation statement. Ping me when export finishes. :thumbsup:
